title: Chitra Katha

language_policy.rule: Every title and every edition carries all three language versions — Hindi, English and Hinglish — in past and future versions alike. No edition is published in one language only.
language_policy.translation_review: Native-language review is required for each edition before any release.

version_policy.rule: Past editions stay readable as history; future editions are added as new versions. Versions are never silently merged or deleted.

monsoon-post.title: The Monsoon Post
monsoon-post.premise: The first monsoon cloud arrives over the city the same morning the old rooftop letter-box disappears. A young guardian of the skies must follow the rain to find it before the last letter is lost.

English: Panel 1 — The morning the first cloud crossed the river…
Panel 2 — …the old letter-box on the rooftop was gone.
Panel 3 — 'One letter is still inside,' said the watchman. 'It has waited forty years.'
Panel 4 — The guardian of the skies looked up. 'Then the rain and I have work to do.'
Hindi: पैनल 1 — जिस सुबह पहला बादल नदी पार आया…
पैनल 2 — …उसी सुबह छत पर पुराना लेटर-बॉक्स गायब था।
पैनल 3 — 'अंदर एक चिट्ठी अब भी है,' चौकीदार ने कहा। 'चालीस साल से इंतज़ार में है।'
पैनल 4 — आसमान के रखवाले ने ऊपर देखा। 'तो बारिश और हम, दोनों को काम करना होगा।'
Hinglish: Panel 1 — Jis subah pehla baadal nadi paar aaya…
Panel 2 — …usi subah chatt purani letter-box gayab thi.
Panel 3 — 'Andar ek chitthi ab bhi hai,' chowkidar ne kaha. 'Chalis saal se intezaar mein hai.'
Panel 4 — Aasman ke rakshak ne upar dekha. 'Toh baarish aur hum — dono ko kaam karna hoga.'

first-flight.title: First Flight
first-flight.premise: A courier girl who has never left her lane is trusted with the city's first solar glider for one evening. Every rooftop wants a delivery; only one parcel matters.

English: Panel 1 — The glider arrived on a cart, folded like a tired bird.
Panel 2 — 'Only one evening,' said the mechanic. 'Only one parcel that matters.'
Panel 3 — She had never flown. The lane had never been quiet.
Hindi: पैनल 1 — ग्लाइडर एक ठेले पर आया, थकी चिड़िया की तरह जुड़ा हुआ।
पैनल 2 — 'सिर्फ़ एक शाम,' मिस्त्री ने कहा। 'और सिर्फ़ एक पार्सल जो मायने रखता है।'
पैनल 3 — उसने कभी उड़ान नहीं भरी थी। गली कभी शांत नहीं हुई थी।
पैनल 4 — दोनों बदल गए, सूर्यास्त के साथ।
Hinglish: Panel 1 — Glider ek thele par aaya, thaki chidiya ki tarah juda hua.
Panel 2 — 'Sirf ek shaam,' mistri ne kaha. 'Aur sirf ek parcel jo mayne rakhta hai.'
Panel 3 — Usne kabhi udaan nahi bhari thi. Gali kabhi shaant nahi hui thi.
Panel 4 — Dono badal gaye, sunset ke saath.
